penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Debugging SDK integration failures in a specific customer's Android codebase is inherently per-customer manual work; a generic guide helps but cannot automate the diagnostic process.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Salesforce MC + Firebase integration issues are highly environment-specific; support queries will require human-judgment triage.

rationale: The pain is real and the business context (broken push delivery on a $$$-per-month Salesforce MC contract) creates genuine urgency, but the signal is a single forum thread — breadth is unvalidated. More critically, the actual value delivery (diagnosing a dual-SDK conflict in a specific Android codebase) is per-customer manual work that Claude cannot automate; a written guide would be free content, not a paid service. The buyer (mobile engineer) may not have purchase authority and the company count paying for this niche is probably very small.
solution_plan: This cannot reliably be packaged as an autonomous micro-service. A static integration guide or PDF could be produced by Claude but would not command recurring revenue. A "managed SDK debugging" service would devolve into per-customer consulting. Drop this opportunity unless multiple additional signals emerge validating that dozens of teams hit this exact problem and have budget to pay for a specialized tool.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy (score 5, floor 7). Signal strength is very weak (single forum post). Drop recommended.
